title: Bihar Flood Evacuation Protocol 2024
content: Standard operating procedure for flood evacuation in Bihar districts. Phase 1: Alert dissemination. Phase 2: Resource mobilization. Phase 3: Evacuation execution. Phase 4: Shelter management.

title: Patna District Disaster Management Plan
content: Comprehensive disaster management plan for Patna district covering floods, earthquakes, and industrial hazards. Includes resource inventory, shelter locations, and communication protocols.

title: Medical Triaging Guidelines for Disasters
content: Triage protocols for mass casualty incidents during disasters. RED: Immediate. YELLOW: Delayed. GREEN: Minor. BLACK: Deceased/Expectant.
